items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: And Rouse come out and see Rouse. That's piano player. And they come out there, I'll sit down in the corner. Well, those who may have sit right around the corner. Yeah, man, we got an opportunity to make some records.

ctx.x: And where do you think he is, man?

A brown there with Joe White. A brown in Natchez. Jack and some other. I'm not sure what he's got me wrong. Let me find out. Yeah. Joe Gaynor walking away, then. Joe Gaynor walking away. 된 된 된 된 Well, you know, when I made that record with them fellas, I hadn't played for six weeks. You hadn't played for six weeks. That's right. I used to get in them snubs, you know. Used to be a fella on Fred and 8. Well, you know, to tell the truth about it, we'd handle liquor. At speakeasy times. So Rouse found out where he…
I was just mowing there. Excuse me, I'll turn it off on a second.
